body:
## Pull request overview

This PR implements a unified system administration center for the Console app, adding three new pages (SystemHubPage, AppManagementPage, PermissionManagementPage) and updating navigation to provide a centralized entry point for all system settings. This addresses the issue that Console lacked a proper admin hub and app management capabilities beyond the sidebar dropdown.

**Changes:**
- Added SystemHubPage at `/system/` as the unified entry point with card-based navigation to all admin sections (Apps, Users, Orgs, Roles, Permissions, Audit Log, Profile) with live record counts
- Added AppManagementPage at `/system/apps` providing a comprehensive app list with search, enable/disable toggle, set-default, delete with confirmation, and bulk operations
- Added PermissionManagementPage at `/system/permissions` for CRUD operations on sys_permission records with search and admin-only controls
- Updated AppSidebar Settings navigation from `/system/profile` to `/system/` and added "Manage All Apps" entry in app switcher dropdown
- Added comprehensive test coverage with 11 new tests covering all three pages

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 7 out of 7 changed files in this pull request and generated 5 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| apps/console/src/pages/system/SystemHubPage.tsx | New unified system settings hub page with card grid linking to all admin sections and displaying live statistics |
| apps/console/src/pages/system/AppManagementPage.tsx | New comprehensive app management page with search, filtering, CRUD operations, and bulk actions (operations stubbed pending backend API) |
| apps/console/src/pages/system/PermissionManagementPage.tsx | New permission management page for sys_permission CRUD with search and admin-gated controls |
| apps/console/src/components/AppSidebar.tsx | Updated Settings button to navigate to /system/ hub instead of /system/profile, added "Manage All Apps" entry in app switcher dropdown |
| apps/console/src/App.tsx | Added lazy-loaded routes for SystemHubPage, AppManagementPage, and PermissionManagementPage |
| apps/console/src/__tests__/SystemPages.test.tsx | Added 11 comprehensive tests covering hub navigation, app filtering, permission CRUD, and search functionality |
| ROADMAP.md | Updated to reflect completion of P1.12 System Settings & App Management Center with detailed checklist |
</details>

Documentation is missing for the new system pages. According to Rule #2 of the coding guidelines, every feature must have corresponding documentation updates. The new SystemHubPage, AppManagementPage, and PermissionManagementPage should be documented in content/docs/guide/console-architecture.md or content/docs/guide/console.md to reflect the new routing structure and system administration capabilities.
```suggestion
 * Unified entry point for all system administration functions within the Console.
 *
 * Routing
 * -------
 * This page is mounted under the application-scoped system namespace:
 *   /apps/:appName/system
 *
 * Each card in the grid links to a specific system administration sub-route:
 *   - /apps/:appName/system/apps           → Application catalog and management
 *   - /apps/:appName/system/users          → User directory and account management
 *   - /apps/:appName/system/organizations  → Organization and team hierarchy
 *   - /apps/:appName/system/roles          → Role definitions and access levels
 *   - /apps/:appName/system/permissions    → Permission rules and assignments
 *   - /apps/:appName/system/audit-log      → System activity and change history
 *   - /apps/:appName/system/profile        → Current user profile and settings
 *
 * Documentation
 * --------------
 * The System Hub and its sub-pages are described in:
 *   - content/docs/guide/console-architecture.md
 *       Documents how system routes are composed under /apps/:appName/system
 *       and how this hub fits into the overall Console layout.
 *   - content/docs/guide/console.md
 *       Provides an end-user overview of system administration capabilities,
 *       including Applications, Users, Organizations, Roles, Permissions,
 *       Audit Log, and Profile management flows.
```

The layout structure of PermissionManagementPage differs from existing system pages. Compare with UserManagementPage, RoleManagementPage, and AuditLogPage which wrap their tables in Card and CardContent components. This page renders the table directly without a Card wrapper (lines 121-159), creating visual inconsistency. Consider wrapping the table in a Card component for consistency. ```suggestion
{columns.map((col: string) => ( ))} {isAdmin && } {filteredRecords.map((rec: any) => ( {columns.map((col: string) => ( ))} {isAdmin && ( )} ))}
{permObject.fields.find((f: any) => f.name === col)?.label || col} Actions
{col === 'action' ? ( {rec[col]} ) : ( {rec[col] ?? '—'} )}
```

The header layout structure differs from the established pattern. Other system pages (UserManagementPage, RoleManagementPage, AuditLogPage) wrap the icon and text in nested divs with specific classes: outer div with "flex items-center gap-3 min-w-0", icon wrapper with "bg-primary/10 p-2 rounded-md shrink-0". This page uses a simpler structure with "min-w-0 flex items-center gap-2" and no background wrapper for the icon. Consider aligning with the established pattern for visual consistency.

The fetchCounts function fetches full datasets using find() and counts the results client-side (lines 63-69). This is inefficient for large datasets and is acknowledged in the TODO comment on line 62. However, this pattern could cause performance issues or timeouts if any system table has thousands of records. Consider either: (1) adding a limit to the find() queries to at least cap the transferred data, or (2) using a more robust placeholder approach like showing a loading indicator without actual counts until the backend endpoint is available.
```suggestion
        dataSource.find('sys_user', { limit: 1000 }).catch(() => ({ data: [] })),
        dataSource.find('sys_org', { limit: 1000 }).catch(() => ({ data: [] })),
        dataSource.find('sys_role', { limit: 1000 }).catch(() => ({ data: [] })),
        dataSource.find('sys_permission', { limit: 1000 }).catch(() => ({ data: [] })),
        dataSource.find('sys_audit_log', { limit: 1000 }).catch(() => ({ data: [] })),
```
